build_Mask2FormerHead: build a Mask2FormerHead instance with configurable num_queries, pixel_decoder, and transformer_decoder for universal image segmentation
forward_Mask2FormerHead: run the Mask2FormerHead forward pass on multi-scale features to get classification and mask prediction logits
loss_Mask2FormerHead: compute classification, mask, and dice losses for all decoder layers during training
forward_test_Mask2FormerHead: run inference with Mask2FormerHead to produce predicted semantic segmentation masks from multi-level features
forward_head_Mask2FormerHead: run the forward_head method to compute classification scores, mask predictions, and attention masks after each decoder layer
